entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
Build a fully functional e-commerce website. The homepage displays a product
catalog (image, name, price) with search and category filters. Clicking a product
opens its detail page. After sign-up/login, users can add items to cart, adjust
quantities, and checkout to place an order — or buy directly from the detail page.
A "My Orders" page lists all orders with full details (items, amount, shipping info,
status). Data must be persisted with pre-loaded products. Teams define their own
order state logic (e.g., how cancellation affects inventory) and keep frontend and
backend in sync. The full flow — Browse → Login → Add to Cart → Checkout →
View Order — must be demo-ready.

Stretch Goals
LLM Shopping Assistant: Convert natural language queries like "camping gear
under ¥300" into product filters — only recommend items that actually exist in
the catalog.
Concurrency-Safe Inventory: Prevent overselling when multiple users order the
same item simultaneously.
